headline: Bitcoin fell to a 12-week low near $67,500 and below its 200-week average as more than $1.6B of leveraged bets were force-closed, with US producer prices due at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok) tonight.

stories.title: Bitcoin hits a 12-week low and slips below its 200-week average
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $67,500, its lowest level since about 19-20 August, before recovering part of the drop. CoinDesk says it is now below its 200-week moving average of about $68,000, a long-term trend line many traders watch. Forced selling added to the fall: traders who borrowed to bet on rising prices had their positions closed automatically by exchanges as prices fell. A HashKey analyst told Decrypt the drop was directly triggered by a wave of these forced closures. Ether dropped 6% to about $1,921, per The Block.
points: The low depends on the data source: $67,449 on CoinGlass data per Cointribune, and $67,652 per CoinDesk.
The Block calls it the lowest since 20 August; CoinDesk says since 19 August.
Leveraged bets force-closed in 24 hours reached $1.64B, $1.46B of them bets on rising prices, per CoinGlass data cited by Cointribune; The Block gave $1.47B earlier in the day.
Average funding rates on perpetual futures turned negative for the first time in a month, per CoinDesk: more traders are now paying to bet on falling prices.
Prices were read at about 7am ET; use the live prices on this page for the current level.

stories.title: US producer prices tonight, with the dollar and bond yields climbing
stories.summary: The October producer price index (PPI), a measure of inflation at the wholesale level, comes out at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok). Traders already expect the Fed to raise rates. Higher rates and a stronger dollar make safe US assets pay more, which tends to pull money away from risky assets like crypto. A hot number could add to that pressure; a cool one could ease it. Separately, Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain, a claim the AP could not independently verify.
points: Consensus is +0.4% on the month (prior +1.3%), core +0.3% (prior +0.7%), and 6.6% on the year (prior 6.3%), per Finviz.
The US Dollar Index climbed above 103 and the 10-year Treasury yield was 5.125%, per CoinDesk.
CME FedWatch shows 88% odds of a quarter-point hike and 12% of a half-point hike, per Decrypt.
Saxo says options markets price about a 1% move in stocks around the release.

stories.title: Big-money exits: ETF outflows, MSCI dropping Strategy, Nvidia CEO exit
stories.summary: Money kept leaving US bitcoin funds, and index provider MSCI will remove Strategy (MSTR), a company that holds large amounts of bitcoin, from its indexes on 30 November, which can bring selling from funds that track those indexes. Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang resigned, with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO, adding to the risk-off mood ahead of Nvidia's results on Tuesday.
points: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $299.8M on Wednesday, $269.7M of it from BlackRock's IBIT, per Farside data cited by Cointribune.
Thursday's figures are still partial: bitcoin ETFs showed $47.7M of outflows before BlackRock and Fidelity reported, per FinanceFeeds.
Strategy shares closed Thursday at $114.41, down about 6.5%, per The Block.
Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member effective immediately, per CoinCentral.

briefs.title: DOJ and CFTC sue Arkansas over Kalshi
briefs.summary: The agencies argue federal law gives the CFTC exclusive power over event contracts, so Arkansas cannot act against Kalshi, and are seeking injunctions, per The Block.

briefs.title: Thailand proposes a daily stablecoin cap
briefs.summary: A Thai SEC draft would limit each customer's stablecoin deposits and withdrawals to 5M baht (about $147,750) per operator per day; comments are due 26 November, per The Block.

briefs.title: JPMorgan raised its Strategy stake 36%
briefs.summary: A filing shows JPMorgan held 848,932 Strategy shares and about $540M of BlackRock's bitcoin ETF as of 30 September, per The Block.

briefs.title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talk puts their bitcoin in focus
briefs.summary: Citing Bloomberg, CoinDesk says a merger could be announced as soon as December; the two hold about 30,220 BTC between them.

briefs.title: US moves to seize $1.2B stolen in the Binance hack
briefs.summary: A court approved seizing or holding more than $1.2B tied to October's Binance hack, part of more than $2.7B frozen so far, per The Block.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks fastest since 2022
briefs.summary: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2B in the 30 days to 9 November, the biggest drop since June 2022, per Glassnode data reported by crypto.news.

briefs.title: TRM Labs launches tool to freeze stolen crypto faster
briefs.summary: TRM's Beacon Concierge has helped freeze more than $35M across 15 cases with 14 agencies; DefiLlama counts $8.78B lost to 341 hacks this year, per The Block.
